import re

def parse(lines):
    pat = re.compile(r'^\s*(\d+)\)\s+(?:"(.*)"|(\S.*?))\s*$')
    items = []
    skip = []
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        m = pat.match(l)
        if m:
            v = m.group(2) if m.group(2) is not None else m.group(3)
            items.append((i, int(m.group(1)), v))
        elif re.match(r'^\s*\((empty|nil|integer|error)', l):
            skip.append(i)
    records = []
    used = []
    j = 0
    while j + 1 < len(items):
        a = items[j]
        b = items[j + 1]
        records.append({"rank": (a[1] + 1) // 2, "member": a[2], "score": b[2]})
        used.append(a[0])
        used.append(b[0])
        j += 2
    blocks = []
    if records:
        blocks.append({"name": "members", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": records})
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
